title: Svelte component contract scan
responsibility: Derives a component’s props, markup output and nested script exports from its source.

inputs.name: instanceScript.code
inputs.description: Svelte source from which comments and module-context scripts are excluded.

inputs.name: componentSource.code
inputs.description: Svelte component or instance TypeScript source to parse without executing it.

inputs.name: propsDeclaration.file
inputs.description: Parsed instance source whose top-level props declaration is selected.

inputs.name: propsType.node
inputs.description: Props variable declaration whose annotation or $props type argument is inspected.

inputs.name: localProps.type
inputs.description: Optional props type node to expand into source-declared fields.

inputs.name: localProps.file
inputs.description: Instance source containing local interfaces and aliases referenced by the props type.

inputs.name: localProps.seen
inputs.description: Visited local type names preventing recursive expansion; defaults to an empty set.

inputs.name: propMembers.members
inputs.description: Interface or object-type members to convert to required or optional prop fields.

inputs.name: boundProps.items
inputs.description: Declared prop fields before destructured binding names and literal defaults are applied.

inputs.name: boundProps.node
inputs.description: Props declaration containing the actual destructuring bindings and defaults.

inputs.name: boundProps.owner
inputs.description: Canonical component name used to qualify each public input.

inputs.name: componentSnippets.code
inputs.description: Svelte source whose authored markup snippets are scanned separately from props and script exports.

inputs.name: componentSnippets.owner
inputs.description: Canonical component name used to qualify each snippet and its parameters.

inputs.name: scanComponent.code
inputs.description: Svelte source containing script blocks and markup.

inputs.name: scanComponent.name
inputs.description: Component symbol name used to prefix prop inputs.

outputs.name: scanComponent
outputs.description: Export scan containing a component symbol with props and markup output, followed by script exports and sorted unique detected error names. Inline $props object types become fields; named/untyped props remain a single props input. Optional props with no binding fallback explicitly use the documentation marker undefined (omitted); required props retain no default and literal fallbacks retain their source value.
